as_of_content:
A '''Damaging [[Debuff]]''' is an ability that slowly drains a [[Bot]]'s health over time.

== Strategies ==
Damaging debuffs can be used against [[Shield (ability)|Shielding]] and [[Resistance Buff]]s.

== List of Damaging Debuffs ==
* [[Bleed]]
* [[Shock]]
* [[Acid]]
* [[Burn]]
[[Category:Abilities]]
